regions.today: Staying rather dull and cloudy for many this evening, with perhaps the odd shower along the east coast. All in mostly light north-westerly breezes.
regions.tonight: Generally dry overnight. However, mist and fog will quickly develop, turning dense in places, especially in rural locations. Chilly with lowest temperatures of 1 to 6 degrees, and just light variable breezes or calm conditions.
regions.tomorrow: Widespread mist and fog will gradually lift throughout the morning, lingering in some places into the afternoon. It will be a dry day for most with some bright or sunny spells developing. Another cool day with highs of just 7 to 10 degrees, and light variable breezes.
